reference.title: Scenario 1 — Title style applied correctly
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document titled Printer User's Guide saved as Printer_Users_Guide.docx.

section.p: Consider a document titled Printer User's Guide saved as Printer_Users_Guide.docx. When the Title style is applied to the text "Printer User's Guide", the converter generates the following DITA bookmap structure:

row.entry: Document Name: Printer_Users_Guide.docx Document Title: Printer User's Guide (Title style applied)

entry.codeblock: <map id="Printer_Users_Guide"> <title>Printer User's Guide</title> </map> OR <bookmap id="Printer_Users_Guide"> <booktitle> <mainbooktitle>Printer User's Guide</mainbooktitle> </booktitle> </bookmap>

section.p: Result:The converter uses the .docx filename, without the .docx extension, as the map @id. The text formatted with the Microsoft Word Title style becomes the DITA map title. Use <map>/<title> for a standard DITA map, or <bookmap>/<booktitle>/<mainbooktitle> only when the target DITA shell supports bookmap.
